messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Given the following text and a relational triplet extracted from it:

Text: Hydrochlorothiazide can raise blood sugar, cholesterol, triglycerides, uric acid and calcium. Your diabetes medicine or insulin dose may need adjusting, and diabetes that was previously unnoticed can become apparent during treatment. The rise in uric acid is related to the dose and can cause gout or make existing gout worse. Because the medicine also affects calcium, it is stopped before parathyroid function tests, so tell any doctor arranging tests that you take it. Your doctor will check these levels from time to time.
Skin cancer risk:
Long-term use of hydrochlorothiazide is linked to a small increase in the risk of non-melanoma skin cancer, mainly squamous cell carcinoma. In a large safety study the increase was about 1 extra case per 16,000 people per year, rising to about 1 extra case per 6,700 people per year among white patients who had taken a total of 50,000 mg or more.
Triplet: ["hydrochlorothiazide (hctz)", "may require adjustment of", "diabetes medicine dose"]

The relation 'may require adjustment of' in the triplet is defined as 'The use of the subject drug may necessitate changes in the dosage or type of the specified medication.' In this context, is there any relation appropriate to replace it? Choose a relation whose meaning and subject/object direction match the triplet even if the wording differs; choose 'None of the above' only if no candidate fits. Please answer by providing only the letter of your choice.

Choices:
A. 'may require dose adjustment': The subject medication might need a change in dosage under certain conditions or over time.
B. 'has product variation': The subject drug has a different formulation or version specified by the object entity.
C. 'interacts with': The subject drug has a drug interaction with the drug or substance specified by the object entity that may change effects or cause harm.
D. 'has recommended dose': The subject drug is typically prescribed at the dose or dosing regimen specified by the object entity.
E. 'has indication for initial dose': The subject drug's initial dose is indicated for the specified medical purpose or condition.
F. None of the above.

Answer:
